usage: The word '少糖' is used to indicate a preference for less sugar in drinks or food.
'少糖' functions as a noun phrase and can be placed after a drink or food item to specify the sugar amount.
You can use '少糖' when ordering at restaurants or cafes to customize your order.
'少糖' is typically used in spoken Cantonese when discussing sweetness levels.
It is common to pair '少糖' with verbs like '要' (want) or '加' (add) to express requests.
